key_highlights: ASX set to fall sharply as Wall Street declines; oil hovers near US$100 amid escalating Iran conflict (headlines 7, 18, 29)
RBA perceived as 'choosing recession' as business conditions hit weakest since pandemic (headlines 47, 48)
Iron ore in sustained downtrend – 'drowning, not waving' – pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG (headlines 44, 80)
WA gold sector sees multiple high-grade discoveries and drill-out funding (headlines 35-38)
Home buyer sentiment collapses; high-end property hit by steepest falls while affordable end resilient (headlines 26, 69)
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns (headline 25)
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars (headlines 29, 32)
China-Trump tensions escalate; ATO opens tax front against Big Tech (headlines 51, 73)

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; offset by strong WA gold discoveries (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway) and copper/silver exploration (Flagship, Patriot). Austal.AX jumps on US$1.9b bid.
sectors.implications: Diversify away from iron ore exposure; gold and copper names offer relative strength. Monitor iron ore contract prices for further downside.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran war escalation; 'next oil crunch' feared. Power giants eye AI data centres at coal plants. NSW power supply concerns. Energy transition disrupted by data centre demand.
sectors.implications: Positive for Woodside.AX, Santos.AX, Origin.AX short-term on oil; but structural energy demand shift toward data centres creates long-term uncertainty for traditional generators.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse in private credit raises contagion fears. RBA 'chooses recession' narrative pressures lending growth. Qantas.AX fires workers with US$35m payout. ATO vs Big Tech tax battle.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cuts and credit stress. Private credit exposure a key risk factor.

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment collapses; high-end property sees steepest falls. Coastal living faces US$850b reckoning. Queenslanders moving west boosting regional property. NZ house crash returns.
sectors.implications: REITs (GP.AX, SPG.AX) and homebuilders (MPL.AX, WBC.AX) under pressure. Regional property may outperform coastal metros.

sectors.trend: AI data centre buildout at coal sites signals infrastructure demand. Novartis trial results pressure Amgen. Visa blockchain integration. SK hynix surge signals semiconductor strength.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SSW.AX stable; AI infrastructure beneficiaries (data centre REITs, power) gain. Healthcare trial risk a watch item.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock from Iran war driving global risk-off
RBA policy dilemma: recession vs inflation with business conditions at pandemic lows
Iron ore structural weakness vs gold/copper rotation in mining
Housing market bifurcation: high-end collapse vs affordable resilience
AI data centre energy demand reshaping power sector
China-Trump trade tensions and ATO tax enforcement

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / Iran war escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over refiners and transport. Monitor Brent/WTI daily.
Reduce financials weight; favour dividend-paying defensives (WES.AX, WOL.AX). Watch RBA statement for forward guidance.
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX) and copper (STO.AX, FMG.AX copper division).
Review bank balance sheet exposure to private credit; favour large-cap diversified banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX).
Reduce REIT and homebuilder exposure; monitor ABS housing data and buyer sentiment index.
Diversify export exposure; monitor iron ore and LNG contract pricing from China.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold producers on high-grade discoveries
opportunities.rationale: Multiple shovel-ready gold hits (Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon, Gateway US$45m drill-out) signal sector upcycle; gold benefits from risk-off and oil-driven inflation.

opportunities.recommendation: Add oil & gas producers on US$100 oil
opportunities.rationale: Iran war sustains elevated crude; Woodside and Santos benefit directly from price spike.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in Austal on US$1.9b bid
opportunities.rationale: M&A catalyst provides near-term upside; defence/marine sector benefits from global spending.

opportunities.recommendation: Copper/silver exploration plays on metal strength
opportunities.rationale: Flagship ups copper stakes; Patriot locks Peruvian silver; red metal soars on supply constraints.

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning' with no near-term demand recovery; China-Trump tensions add downside risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim financials; shift to consumer staples defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA recession narrative and Bathla credit stress pressure NIMs; WES and WOL offer defensive yield.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight high-end REITs and coastal property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Buyer sentiment collapse and US$850b coastal reckoning signal structural de-rating in premium segments.
Risk-off global environment with oil spike pressures AUD; Wall Street decline transmits to ASX.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) faces sharp downside as oil nears US$100, Wall Street sells off, and RBA recession fears dominate. Iron ore weakness and private credit stress compound the risk-off. Expect 3-5% index decline in coming weeks. Gold and oil names outperform; financials and iron ore lag.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. RBA likely to cut rates, supporting rate-sensitive sectors but signalling economic weakness. Iron ore structural decline continues unless China stimulus materialises. Gold, copper, and energy transition (AI data centres) offer structural growth. Housing bifurcation persists. Business conditions at pandemic lows suggest a prolonged soft patch.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (recession vs inflation balance)
Iran war escalation / oil price trajectory above US$100
Iron ore contract price and China demand data
Bathla fallout and private credit market stability
ABS housing and buyer sentiment data
ATO Big Tech tax enforcement outcomes

ABS CPI, unemployment, retail sales releases
China PMI and trade policy signals
WA gold production and exploration updates
NSW/Queensland power demand and data centre approvals
